claims.claim: Attentional blink is temporary impaired report of T2 under particular RSVP timing and task
claims.limit: Do not claim literal eye blink or universal time interval.

claims.claim: Raymond et al original task showed temporary probe impairment at a limited interval
claims.limit: Task, probe and controls matter.

claims.claim: 1994 follow-up tested seven RSVP experiments and disputed simple demand account
claims.limit: Mechanistic interpretation remains qualified.

claims.limit: NOT Zen12 test; no guaranteed customer outcome.

claims.claim: 2026 mindfulness internal attention review offers explanatory framework
claims.limit: Not a product efficacy evaluation.

claims.claim: Zen12 advertises twelve minutes equivalent to hour
claims.limit: Must not repeat as fact or CTA promise.

claims.claim: Zen12 advertises health, stress and focus gains
claims.limit: Omit efficacy representations absent adequate product-specific substantiation.

claims.claim: Zen12 Beginner first six levels, 24 MP3s
claims.limit: Do not confuse with complete Premium.

claims.claim: Zen12 Premium all twelve levels, 48 MP3s
claims.limit: Verify purchase contents again before release.

claims.claim: Zen12 Advanced final six levels, 24 MP3s
claims.limit: Not the same as Beginner or Premium.

claims.claim: Zen12 seller free gift also subscribes to separate newsletter
claims.limit: Explicitly distinguish from FV Jetpack list.

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live Total Focus is seller-described 33-min,47MB audio
claims.limit: Not proof of hypnosis benefit or partner authorization.

claims.claim: Brainwave Shots Focus Shot includes 15-min and 30-min versions
claims.limit: Not proof of brainwave entrainment outcome.

claims.claim: Merchant product pages show promotional prices
claims.limit: Do not hard-code price or claim live checkout totals.

claims.claim: Merchant promises money-back terms on some SKU pages
claims.limit: No audited successful refund; omit risk-free language.

claims.claim: Public Inspire3 affiliate network recruits partners and advertises commissions
claims.limit: No payout rate or EPC in FV copy; must authenticate signed actual account terms.

claims.claim: FV-specific Inspire3 partner acceptance
claims.limit: Gmail searches found consumer marketing, not publisher approval; dashboard not authenticated.

claims.claim: FV-specific earning URL and tracked commission
claims.limit: Never invent or activate URL.

claims.claim: FTC requires material-connection disclosure clear/conspicuous near endorsement
claims.limit: Show plainly beside recommendation and active link if later approved.

claims.claim: Health-related claims require appropriate science substantiation
claims.limit: Absent product-specific adequate evidence omit.

claims.claim: Historical Puységur source trail establishes magnetism as physical medical mechanism
claims.limit: History of claims is not causal efficacy.

claims.claim: FV Focus Fieldbook published 52-page free existing list
claims.limit: Do not add duplicate form/welcome.

claims.claim: FV currently has live Mind route
claims.limit: Do not assert /mind/ is live; review HTML only.

claims.claim: Grok asset IDs and matching live mobile routes for three candidate topics
claims.limit: Need Praxxis/Grok TASK-008 readback and QA.

claims.claim: FV owned Payhip active rights-cleared Mind SKU
claims.limit: Do not conflate public listing with seller ownership/license/delivery.

claims.claim: Merchant-confirmed affiliate commission or FV paid order
claims.limit: Net revenue/1000 qualified humans NOT COMPUTABLE.

claims.claim: Video variant B has a playable encoded original film
claims.limit: Source-controlled SVG, transcript, captions only.

claims.claim: Seller swipe creatives approved for FV's specific marketing channels
claims.limit: No copied creative and no published marketing until written terms.

claims.claim: One existing FV Dispatch route, no second list or imported addresses
claims.limit: Do not modify welcome or newsletter drafts.

claims.claim: A/B original film improves paid conversion
claims.limit: Needs eligible merchant, controlled allocation and paid reconciliation.
